_about: Thomas Lovell Beddoes. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Death's Jest-Book; Poems. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

beddoes-poetical-works: The Poetical Works of Thomas Lovell Beddoes, vol. II
beddoes-poetical-works-2: The Poetical Works of Thomas Lovell Beddoes, vol. I

beddoes-poetical-works.year: 1890 (vol. I title page 'LONDON J. M. DENT AND CO. ... 1890')
beddoes-poetical-works.evidence: Read vol. II djvu: 'VOL. II', contents 'DEATH'S JEST-BOOK; OR THE FOOL'S TRAGEDY ... 5' and 'FRAGMENTS OF DEATH'S JEST-BOOK'. Collection university_of_toronto.
beddoes-poetical-works.case: Bloom lists Death's Jest-Book; nothing by Beddoes is held. Gosse's 1890 Dent edition prints it in vol. II.
beddoes-poetical-works.note: Vol. II is from the same set as vol. I (entry 446); its title page date was not separately read.

beddoes-poetical-works-2.year: 1890 (title page 'LONDON J. M. DENT AND CO. 69 GREAT EASTERN STREET 1890')
beddoes-poetical-works-2.evidence: Read djvu title page and contents: Memoir, then 'POEMS COLLECTED IN 1851' (Alfarabi, Pygmalion, Dream-Pedlary...). Collection university_of_toronto.
beddoes-poetical-works-2.case: Bloom lists Beddoes's poems. Gosse's two-volume Poetical Works is the standard 19th-century collected edition.
beddoes-poetical-works-2.note: Donner's 1928 Complete Works would also be PD (not checked).
